note: Every change is logged under its version with its date. 'date' is the day the change reached main (the PR's merge date, UTC); a version's 'effective' date is its first signal day. GitHub has no tags, releases or branches for V1/V2, so the references are the introducing pull requests and the version-history file.

versions.label: Strategy Logic V2
versions.summary: Fixes the three drains the 2026-10 loss review found — slow trend sleeves whipsawed after the gold, rare-earth and Bitcoin-miner up-trends broke, a daily priority tilt that re-sized every held sleeve, and stops that never became a CLOSE — then adds portfolio-level guard-rails: an adds-only allocator, a 30 % parent-cluster cap, and (Balanced) a fixed crypto split, a crypto cluster that may add, and a 30 % SATA cap. Net effect on the walk-forward replay: similar return, roughly half the drawdown.

headline.as_of: 2026-10-12 snapshot, production seed, walk-forward replay (V1 → V2)

versions.label: Strategy Logic V1
versions.summary: The first stamped logic generation: look-ahead-free, honest-fill sleeve retunes (dual-MA 25/100 gold with −3 % fixed stops, WGMI SMA50 + volatility filter, REMX 50/200 golden cross with a −5 % stop, the XLE crash shield) feeding a daily gated allocator that re-sized every held sleeve each day by anchor × entry-priority, water-filled to per-sleeve caps, with idle capital parked in SATA. Every published book is stamped with its logic version so old and new performance are never conflated.

links.label: PR #114 — V1 basis: look-ahead-free back-tests + honest-fill retunes (2026-07-25)
PR #126 — strategy-version provenance, V1 stamped on every book (2026-07-31)

entries.title: Daily audited refresh and gated Target Book publish
entries.description: A 7:15 AM CT job refreshes every signal, audits that each app's bar is fresh, and publishes the signed Target Book only if the audit passes.

entries.title: Causal daily H/L models and re-tuned divergence thresholds
entries.description: Gold and ticker apps' daily high/low models made causal (no look-ahead) and their divergence thresholds re-tuned on honest data.

entries.title: XLE crash-shield strategy
entries.description: Energy sleeve trades the XLE crash shield (exit when XLE falls 30 % below its 52-week high); its beta sleeves (OIH and the 2× ERX) trade off the same signal.

entries.title: Gold middle path: dual-MA 25/100 for GLDM and UGL, divergence for GDX and NUGT
entries.description: Gold trades the 25/100 dual-MA cross (GLDM and UGL); the miners (GDX and NUGT) trade a divergence strategy off the GLDM signal. Split into two apps: Gold Trend and Gold Miners.

entries.title: Look-ahead bias removed from every back-test; sleeves re-tuned on honest fills
entries.description: All app back-tests rebuilt without look-ahead, data refreshed, sleeve parameters re-tuned and the Overall blend rebuilt — the parameter basis of V1 (gold dual-MA 25/100 with −3 % fixed stops, WGMI SMA50 + vol filter, REMX 50/200 golden cross with a −5 % stop).
entries.impact: Back-tests no longer flatter the strategy; every later V1/V2 number is measured on this footing.

entries.title: Water-fill fix: spill redistributed when a recipient hit its own cap
entries.description: The allocator dropped overflow weight when the sleeve receiving it was itself capped; the spill is now re-spread correctly.

entries.title: Strategy-version provenance and the V1 as-published record
entries.description: Every published book is stamped with its logic version (and commit); the as-published P&L admits only current-logic books, and the V1 record starts 2026-07-31. A version badge appears on every app.
entries.impact: Old-logic and current-logic performance can no longer be conflated.

entries.title: Strategy Health — the four-monitor decay watchdog
entries.description: Book-vs-replay tracking, drawdown tripwires, rolling edge vs buy-and-hold and last-20-trade expectancy, computed nightly and committed.

entries.title: Signals generated only from closed sessions
entries.description: Signatures use completed sessions only, so intraday prices can no longer flicker a signal.

entries.title: Closed-market freeze on the recommended live book
entries.description: On weekends and holidays the live recommendation is pinned to the published book; only committed signal changes can move it, so stale sleeves are not re-sized on days they cannot trade.

entries.title: Data-quality gate with pinned snapshots
entries.description: Back-test inputs are validated and pinned so results stop drifting intraday; newly added sessions are cross-checked against an independent tape.

entries.title: On-time 7:15 AM CT publishes and committed-signal hardening
entries.description: An external scheduler plus a dispatch relay makes the daily publish on-time; committed signals ignore the in-progress bar.

entries.title: Gold (GLDM, UGL): rising-SMA gate and trailing stops
entries.description: The 25/100 cross is taken only while the 100-day SMA is rising; a 10 % (GLDM) / 12 % (UGL) trailing stop replaces the −3 % fixed stop.

entries.title: WGMI: entry only while BTC is above its 50-day SMA
entries.description: A parent-signal gate keeps the miners out of rallies when Bitcoin's own trend is broken.

entries.title: REMX: hold only while SMA20 > SMA100
entries.description: Entry is unchanged; the position is held only while the 20-day SMA stays above the 100-day.

entries.title: Adds-only allocator
entries.description: A held sleeve is never trimmed by the daily tilt and is added to only when its target rises by 8 percentage points or more (fresh entries and exits unchanged).
entries.impact: Fewer resize days and a shallower drawdown: Balanced replay −24.6 % → −17.1 % max drawdown, Sharpe 1.62 → 1.95 at similar return.

entries.title: Stop and trail hits publish a CLOSE
entries.description: A stop or trail that fires at the latest close now publishes CLOSE, so the account sells exactly where the back-test went flat.
entries.impact: V1 published ENTER and the position was silently kept — UGL's −3 % stop became a −15 % hold.

entries.title: V1 / V2 / Combined views everywhere
entries.description: Every P&L, back-test, historical and health view offers Strategy V1, Strategy V2 and Combined (each day under the logic in effect).

entries.title: 30 % parent-cluster cap
entries.description: Sleeves that trade one parent signal (XLE→XOP/ERX, GLDM→UGL, SOXX→SOXL, GDX→NUGT, BTC→MSTR/MSTU/ETH) can never exceed 30 % of the book combined.
entries.impact: Balanced replay (3 seeds): max drawdown −18.7 % → −13.5 %, Sharpe 1.8 → 2.1 at about the same return.

entries.title: XOP replaces OIH in the energy beta slot
entries.description: Same XLE crash-shield signal and no stop, but XOP (oil & gas E&P) keeps OIH's beta to XLE with shallower drawdowns; OIH stays in the XLE app and the V1 record.

entries.title: Combined replay is a splice of the V1 and V2 replays
entries.description: Combined = V1's replay to the day before the cut-over, then V2's logic continuing from the book V1 last held — identical to V1 before 2026-10-09.

entries.title: Live multi-account strict-MOC executor (Option C)
entries.description: Several live IBKR accounts trade the signed live book at the close with market-on-close orders only.

entries.title: Balanced: fixed crypto-cluster split MSTR 45 / MSTU 30 / BTC 20 / ETH 5
entries.description: The crypto cluster's weight is divided by a fixed ordered split instead of the tilt's erratic one (which could put 29 % of the book in BTC or 25 % in ETH).
entries.impact: Balanced replay (3 seeds, 5 bp): +885 % → +950 %, Sharpe 1.93 → 1.98; hold-out 2025-07→ +146 % → +149 %.

entries.title: Balanced: the crypto cluster may add after entry
entries.description: The adds-only band for the crypto cluster is 0 pp instead of 8: a held crypto sleeve is added to whenever its target rises and is never trimmed by the tilt (30 % cluster cap still binds).
entries.impact: +950 % → +1,062 %, Sharpe 1.98 → 2.00, better on all three seeds; accepted despite a small production-seed hold-out cost (Sharpe 2.89 vs 2.96, ~0.4 pt deeper drawdown).

entries.title: SATA capped at 30 % of the book, excess held in cash at 0 %
entries.description: Idle capital is parked in SATA only up to 30 % of the book (both profiles); the rest stays in cash. The live book carries SATA ≤ 30 % plus cash; the paper book is unchanged. V1 has no cap; Combined applies it from the cut-over.
entries.impact: Bounds SATA price exposure. Balanced replay (3 seeds, no costs): +1,241 % → +1,196 %, max drawdown unchanged — the cost is the lost coupon on the cash.

entries.title: Strategy Change Log page
entries.description: New sidebar page listing V1 and V2 with release dates, GitHub references and a dated log of every change under its version; every future change is logged here (see CLAUDE.md).

entries.title: Live executor: whole-share sells never exceed holdings; tolerates a slow account subscription
entries.description: Whole-share MOC plans round sells down (never above what the account holds) and report the fractional dust they cannot close; the positions cross-check retries a slow account-updates subscription and falls back to valuing positions at live quotes instead of refusing a good account.
entries.impact: Found in the first multi-account preview: a 22.8672-share close was sent as 23 shares, and two of three accounts aborted with 'positions read explains $0'.

entries.title: Live executor: every gateway request has a deadline (no hang on a silent gateway)
entries.description: Account-updates, positions, open-orders, quotes and contract lookups now run with a timeout instead of ib_async's wait-forever blocking calls; an account whose feed the gateway never serves falls back to live quotes, and a contract that cannot be resolved skips only that order.
entries.impact: The first retry in the position cross-check (PR #202) called a blocking request and hung the preview on accounts whose account-updates the gateway does not serve.

entries.title: Live executor applies the 30 % SATA cap to books published before it
entries.description: A book without a signed sata_cap now gets the executor's 30 % default (excess stays cash), so a deploy cap can no longer push a pre-cap book to 75 % SATA; a book's own cap still wins and the fallback can be switched off.
entries.impact: First live preview on the pre-cap 40 %-SATA book: 25 % deploy cap -> SATA 75 %; now SATA 30 %, risk 25 %, cash 45 %.

entries.title: Deploy cap is the total invested across all assets (SATA included)
entries.description: --max-deploy-frac / max_deploy_frac now caps the TOTAL the book may deploy, scaling every position including SATA by the same factor and leaving the rest of the account as cash; previously it capped only the risk assets and parked the freed weight in SATA.
entries.impact: On the live book with a 25 % cap: invested 55 % (risk 25 % + SATA 30 %) -> 25 % in total (SATA 8.3 %, risk 16.7 %), 75 % cash.

entries.title: Live executor production hardening
entries.description: Per-order sanity limits (no oversell, buy <= 40 % of NAV, <= 25 orders), PC-vs-IBKR clock check, USD-only accounts, holiday-calendar expiry guard, post-trade verdict (exit 5 + alert), gateway-connect retry, order tags, atomic report writes, reports published without sweeping in other staged files, log rotation, runtime versions logged, and scheduled tasks no longer run as administrator.
entries.impact: Closes the gaps found in the executor security / production review; no change to what the strategy trades.

entries.title: Dead-man's switch and 4:15 PM reconcile
entries.description: Each scheduled run pings an outside monitor (healthchecks.io / Uptime Kuma) so a PC that is off or a lapsed gateway login raises an alarm. A new read-only reconcile task at 4:15 PM ET checks every account's fills against its executed book, repairs a missing/stale report from IBKR executions, and alerts on unfilled or still-working orders.
entries.impact: Closes the silent-failure gaps: a run that never started, and a run that died before recording its fills.

entries.title: One-command Windows live setup; account data stays off GitHub
entries.description: setup_live.ps1 + live_setup.py: finds the installed IB Gateway version and Java, builds StartGateway-live.bat and the live IBC config, discovers the accounts, registers the run/reconcile/gateway-autostart/watchdog tasks and retires paper. Live execution reports are no longer pushed to GitHub (opt-in IBKR_PUBLISH_REPORTS=1), account data paths are git-ignored, and a test fails if a real account id is committed.
entries.impact: Streamlines setup (docs/LIVE_SETUP_WINDOWS.md) and keeps account numbers, balances and holdings private.

entries.title: Encrypted report vault
entries.description: With IBKR_VAULT_KEY set, live execution reports are published only as an AES-256-GCM vault (opaque file names, sealed manifest, path-bound tags) under data/overall/vault; the Executed Book page decrypts it into a temp folder with the same key.
entries.impact: Lets the cloud app show live reports without account numbers, balances or holdings being readable on GitHub.

entries.title: Paper book carries the SATA leg; C2 refuses non-paper books
entries.description: The published paper book now has the same weights as the live book, idle cash parked in SATA up to the V2 cap; the two differ only in book_mode. publish_c2.py aborts unless book_mode is 'paper'.
entries.impact: C2 and the paper record hold the same book as live (including the SATA coupon) while the live/paper separation guards stay intact.

entries.title: C2 record earns the SATA coupon on the held SATA leg
entries.description: The as-published C2 record accrues the SATA coupon on the SATA weight the books now hold; idle cash (and older books' cash remainder) still earns nothing. C2 publish also refuses a book whose SATA leg sizes to under one share.
entries.impact: Keeps the record in step with the paper book that now carries SATA, without retroactively crediting older cash.

entries.title: Executed book explains unfilled orders
entries.description: Each trade now records IBKR's own refusal/cancel message (broker_msg) when it does not fill, and the Executed book trades table shows the Reason (including SKIPPED-… causes) and Broker message columns.
entries.impact: An order that fails (e.g. an IRA restriction) can be diagnosed from the book instead of the executor log.

entries.title: Live positions quote held names outside current sleeves
entries.description: The Live positions section now fetches spot quotes for any held symbol that is not a current sleeve (e.g. OIH after the V2 swap to XOP), instead of showing it unpriced with $0 value and no P&L.
entries.impact: A not-yet-sold retired holding is marked to market rather than excluded from P&L.

entries.title: IRA accounts trade GLDM in place of UGL
entries.description: IBKR IRAs cannot buy UGL. Accounts of type "ira" now re-assign any UGL weight to GLDM at execution (same capital, added to any GLDM already in the book); the published book also carries GLDM's price whenever UGL is held. Overridable per account via "substitutions" in ibkr_accounts.json.
entries.impact: Gold-trend capital in an IRA stays invested at 1x instead of the UGL order being rejected; margin accounts are unchanged.

entries.title: Executor guards for broken markets: quote sanity, stress gate, fill tripwire, NAV brake, live kill switch
entries.description: The IBKR executor now (1) skips a leg whose live quote is halted, crossed or too wide (buys 2 %, sells 4 %) and never escalates an unfilled limit into a MARKET order against such a book; (2) withholds all buys - sells still go - when SPY is more than 8 % from its prior close, VIX is above 50, or a single ordered name has moved more than 40 %; (3) stops sending buys and alerts when a sell fills more than 1 % through the touch it was priced off; (4) runs de-risk-only when net liquidation is more than 15 % below the previous execution report; (5) re-reads the kill switch between orders and cancels orders still working. Every limit is a flag/env var and 0 turns it off; unmeasurable inputs (no VIX feed, no quote) never block a run.
entries.impact: Protects against bad prices and catastrophic-day execution without changing an ordinary day: thresholds are set to stay silent on normal volatility (the April-2025 VIX peak close was about 52).

entries.title: Executor run-health: partial-run alert, margin-call check, forgotten kill switch, all-legs-withheld alert
entries.description: The executor now (1) alerts loudly and records the real fills when a run dies after orders were transmitted (sells without their buys), keeping the send lock so nothing is re-sent; (2) refuses to trade, with an alert, when the account's excess liquidity is at or below zero or under 5 % of net liquidation, so it never fights IBKR's own margin system (--min-margin-cushion / IBKR_MIN_MARGIN_CUSHION, 0 disables, unreadable passes); (3) alerts every run while the kill switch is armed instead of skipping silently; (4) alerts when orders were planned but every leg was withheld; (5) treats a halted SPY as market-wide stress (buys withheld).
entries.impact: Closes the silent failure modes around the market-stress guards: the guards decide what may be sent, these make sure a half-done, blocked or withheld run is reported rather than looking like a quiet success. No change to an ordinary day.

entries.title: Executor book checks: profile pin, book-change hold, soft price drift, immediate MOC-refusal alert
entries.description: The executor now (1) aborts when the published book's profile differs from the account's pinned expected_profile; (2) holds the day's BUYS, with an alert, when the book adds more than 60 % of NAV in new target weight versus the last book that account saw, or an unpinned account's profile changed - sells and de-risking are never held, and IBKR_ACCEPT_LARGE_CHANGE=1 overrides for one run; (3) holds the buy of an unlevered ETF quoting 10 %+ from its book price instead of aborting the run (leveraged, single-stock and crypto names exempt; the 25 % hard abort is unchanged); (4) alerts immediately, and re-checks every minute, when the broker refuses a MOC order.
entries.impact: A signed-but-wrong book (profile switch, corrupted weights) can no longer open large positions unseen, and a refused closing-auction order is reported while it can still be fixed before the 15:50 ET cutoff. Nothing is held on an ordinary day.

entries.title: Executor: report publishing needs cryptography, and the MOC wait now reaches the auction
entries.description: Two failures seen on the first live run: (1) the runner traded and then crashed with "No module named 'cryptography'" while publishing the encrypted reports, because requirements-ibkr.txt (what the executor host installs) did not list it - it does now, and a test scans the executor's import chain (including lazy imports) against that file; (2) the post-submit wait was capped at 40 minutes, so a 2:15 PM CT start stopped waiting about 3 minutes before the 4:00 PM ET auction and wrote the report with every leg still Submitted - the ceiling is now 60 minutes, an early start that would still be capped prints a warning, the per-account child timeout is floored at the ceiling plus 5 minutes (an old config value of 3000 is raised), and the systemd unit allows 4500 s.
entries.impact: Reports are written after the fills rather than before them, the run no longer ends in a false 'not fully filled' exit, and a missing dependency on the executor host can no longer slip in unnoticed.

entries.title: Executed Book page: fix crash when reading reports from the encrypted vault
entries.description: The first time the Streamlit app read the encrypted report vault, every IBKR account page failed with "ValueError: ... is not in the subpath of '/mount/src/btc-range-model'": the decrypted reports sit in a temp folder outside the repo and the page labelled them with Path.relative_to. A small tested helper (scripts/report_label.py, kept out of the hashed app modules so the P&L snapshot fingerprint is untouched) now labels a vault copy as 'encrypted vault: accounts/<ACCT>/...' and leaves repo-relative labels unchanged.
entries.impact: IBKR executed books published through the vault now render in the Streamlit app, in both the Latest run and Historical tabs.

entries.title: Executed Book: live accounts are judged against the live target book
entries.description: The allocation-drift table compared every execution report with target_book.json, the PAPER book, which has no SATA and holds 40 % cash. Each live IBKR account therefore showed SATA target 0 % (drift +30 pp) and cash target 40 % (drift -30 pp) although the executor had traded the live book (SATA 30 %, cash 10 %). The Latest-run tab now picks the book by the report's account mode (small helper in scripts/drift_target.py, outside the hashed app modules), says so when the live book is missing instead of silently using the paper one, and flags a live report compared with a paper book. The Historical tab already used the live book archive and is unchanged.
entries.impact: For a live account that holds the book, every row now reads ~0 pp drift (checked on a rendered page: SATA 30.0 / 30.0, cash 10.0 / 10.0) instead of +30 / -30.

entries.title: Overall: per-account IBKR picker in Current Positions
entries.description: The Current Positions section on the Overall page always showed the first IBKR account's report. With the IBKR source selected it now offers one radio option per IBKR account ("IBKR Account #<id>"), each showing that account's own cost basis and cash.

entries.title: Overall: Current Positions reads the encrypted IBKR account reports
entries.description: The per-account IBKR picker only looked in local data/overall/accounts, but the account reports live in the encrypted vault, so no accounts were found. The Overall page now opens the vault the same way the Executed Book page does, so each IBKR account appears as its own option.

entries.title: Overall: cut CPU use to stop Streamlit Cloud throttling
entries.description: The Overall page's auto-refresh now ticks every 120s instead of 45s, pauses after 30 minutes without a click (resuming on the next interaction), and renders only the selected tab on each run instead of all four. No signal, allocation or P&L logic changed.
entries.impact: Streamlit Community Cloud throttled the app for CPU; every open tab re-executed the whole page, including ~1,000 lines of hidden-tab charts, every 45s.

entries.title: Overall: live cockpit loads the CI-built strategy results
entries.description: The daily snapshot build now also stores the V1 and V2 per-instrument strategy results, and the Overall page loads them instead of re-running every instrument's engine in the web process (the 30–60s CPU spike every 30 minutes). It falls back to computing live if the snapshot is missing, stale, built by different code, or the pinned data changed since the build; the Recompute-live toggle and the freshness-audit retry also bypass it. No signal or allocation logic changed.
entries.impact: Removes the heaviest CPU job in the Streamlit Cloud container (~22s of CPU per generation per cache expiry).

entries.title: BTC page: stop the 60-second reload loop when idle
entries.description: The BTC page re-ran its whole script every 60s forever, holding a server thread asleep in between. It now stops after 30 minutes without a click and resumes on the next interaction.

entries.title: P&L snapshot moves off main and shrinks 3x
entries.description: The daily P&L/results snapshot is now xz-compressed (about 1 MB instead of 2.9 MB gzip) and published to a force-pushed single-commit data-snapshots branch instead of being committed to main; the app downloads it every 30 minutes and still falls back to computing live if it is missing or stale. No signal or allocation logic changed.
entries.impact: Stops ~25–50 MB/month of unreclaimable binary growth in the repository history.

entries.title: Walk-forward replay: entry price of a sleeve added at the cut-over, and entry dates in Current Positions
entries.description: In the Combined view a sleeve V1 never held (XOP) took its entry price from the standalone V2 run, which could be years old, so the replay's Current Positions showed a stale cost and an inflated P&L. The spliced book now enters it at the last pre-cut close. Every Current Positions card also shows the date the position was opened (broker/replay date, else the engine's entry date tagged engine).
entries.impact: XOP replay cost moves from $70.62 (old standalone entry) to the 2026-10-08 close; its open P&L and share count are no longer overstated.

entries.title: Overall: optimiser output comes from the CI snapshot too
entries.description: The daily snapshot now also stores each view/profile's weight-optimiser result, and the Overall page reuses it (under the same returns-matrix match as the replay) instead of re-running the optimiser on every cold cache, which is what the "Optimising the allocation and replaying the back-test…" spinner was waiting on. Verified identical to a live recompute for V2 and Combined, Balanced and Growth. No signal or allocation logic changed.
entries.impact: Removes about 6–10 s of CPU per cache miss (about 2 s Balanced + 4 s Growth locally, more on the throttled cloud container); snapshot grows by about 10 KB.

entries.title: Overall: lighter CPU use to avoid Streamlit throttling
entries.description: The live-price auto-refresh now ticks every 5 min (was 2 min) and pauses after 15 min idle (was 30). "Recompute live (slow)" switches itself off after 10 minutes and suspends the auto-refresh while on. No signal or allocation logic changed.
entries.impact: Cuts timer-driven script re-runs by about 2.5x and stops a forgotten live-recompute toggle from re-running the heavy replays; aimed at the Community Cloud CPU throttle.

entries.title: Current Positions: open dates come only from the book
entries.description: Executed-book (C2 / IBKR) positions show the open date the book recorded, or "not available"; they no longer borrow the engine's entry date. The walk-forward replay still takes its date from the strategy engine.
entries.impact: Avoids showing an engine date as if it were the account's real fill date.

entries.title: Strategy P&L: pick C2 or an IBKR account for the as-published record
entries.description: The Performance source radio now has one "As-published record" option with an Account picker under it: the Collective2 model account or any IBKR account that has executed the book. IBKR accounts are now found in the encrypted vault as well as the local folder, the same way Current Positions finds them.
entries.impact: On the deployed app the per-account reports live only in the vault, so IBKR accounts never appeared in the P&L source list before.

entries.title: Strategy P&L: IBKR records no longer borrow Collective2 wording or data
entries.description: With an IBKR account picked, the start-date default, notices, chart caption and help text now refer to that account's first executed day instead of Collective2, and the trade log no longer lists C2's fills.
entries.impact: Keeps each account's record self-contained, so an IBKR result is never explained with the C2 account's dates or fills.

entries.title: Strategy P&L (C2 record): figures follow C2's executed fills
entries.description: With the Collective2 account picked, Portfolio value now, P&L, CAGR, drawdown, Sharpe and the other metrics are computed from C2's actual fills (entry/exit prices, shares, commissions) marked daily at official closes instead of compounding the archived target books. The books remain the fallback, and a reference line shows books vs executed.
entries.impact: Removes the gap between the C2 account card and Portfolio value now: both rest on the same executed fills.

entries.title: Strategy P&L (C2 record): everything under the dates follows C2's executed positions
entries.description: The daily weights, SATA/cash legs, trade log, win rates, attribution and sleeve tables under the date pickers are now rebuilt from the positions C2 actually held each day (its fills), not the archived target books, so they agree with Portfolio value now and the headline metrics.
entries.impact: Before, only the headline curve used the fills; the figures beneath it still came from the modelled books.

entries.title: Strategy P&L (C2 record): Total portfolio value and Portfolio value now agree
entries.description: The executed-fills record now defaults its start to the account's opening bar (starting capital) instead of the first fill day's close, so the first day's fill-to-close move and opening commissions are counted. The Collective2 card's Total portfolio value reads the same executed curve, at the last official close.
entries.impact: The two cards differed because one was measured from the Oct 7 close as cost basis and the other from initial capital, and because one was marked live and the other at the last close.

entries.title: Executed Book: drift table and donut reconcile cash with net liq
entries.description: The report's cash (TotalCashValue) and net liq (NetLiquidation) are separate IBKR reads. When cash disagrees with net liq minus holdings by more than 2% of net liq, the drift table and donut now show cash as net liq minus holdings and say so; a caption flags any Actual column that does not total ~100%.
entries.impact: …4574 showed Actual % totalling 121.8% and a +21.5 pp cash drift while holdings were 90.3% of net liq (target 90%).

entries.title: Execution report: cash no longer recorded stale after MOC fills
entries.description: The executor read TotalCashValue separately from NetLiquidation and the portfolio, and the cash tag can lag fills. The report now records net liq minus holdings when the cash tag disagrees by more than 2% of net liq (ibkr_common.consistent_cash).
entries.impact: …4574 on 2026-10-13 recorded cash $145,084 (31.5%) against an implied $44,591 (9.7%): the ~$100k gap was that day's two MOC buys.

entries.title: Collective2 card shows C2's own Total Portfolio value
entries.description: The Collective2 account card's Total portfolio value now displays the value C2 itself reports (ModelAccountValue), scaled to the initial capital, instead of the value rebuilt from fills.
entries.impact: The C2 card is the published record, so it reads the figure C2 shows.

entries.title: Strategy P&L (IBKR as-published): follows the executed playbook's holdings
entries.description: The IBKR as-published record is now rebuilt from the shares each executed run actually held, marked at official closes, instead of compounding the target books. Portfolio value therefore tracks the Executed Book's net liquidation and differs only by the cost of trading, which the IBKR Pro costs toggle takes out.
entries.impact: Live accounts 2026-10-12 to 10-16: replay vs reported net liquidation was +0.0% to +1.2% (…4574 missed two unfilled first-day MOC buys, XLE and ERX); now within 0.07% on all three.

entries.title: 2:00 PM CT intraday stop check: a breached stop now reaches today's book
entries.description: About 20 minutes before the executor, every held sleeve that carries a stop (fixed −3…−10 % or the 10 %/12 % gold trail) is priced at its live quote. If one is at/below its stop level, both signed books (paper and live) are re-published in place without that sleeve (adds-only pinned to the morning book, nothing else trimmed), so the IBKR executor, the 2:30 PM Collective2 send and the as-published record all see the stop-out the same day instead of the next morning. A clear day touches only a status marker.
entries.impact: Backtest stops read the same bar's close and fill at it; a live book can only act on the previous close, so a breach used to cost a full extra session. Limits: the rule is a close rule, so a 2:00 PM breach that recovers into the close is sold anyway; a manual 🚀 publish afterwards drops the amendment.

entries.title: Live executor: configurable order type, 2:20 PM CT slot (marketable limit recommended)
entries.description: The multi-account live runner gains an order_type setting — marketable-limit (the new default: a limit priced 0.5 % through the touch that escalates to market if unfilled), moc (the previous strict market-on-close flow, now opt-in) or market — and its shipped schedule moves from 2:15 PM to 2:20 PM CT. Non-MOC runs use a regular-session window instead of the MOC cutoff, send sells first and size the buys from realised proceeds, and alert when the 2 PM stop check did not complete.
entries.impact: Replay on the common hourly window (2024-06-18 → 2026-06-15, Balanced book with the 30 % cluster cap): fills at the 4 PM close +329 %, ~10 AM ET +307 %, the open +286 % — close ahead but not statistically significant (daily t = −0.6 / −1.1), so the move to a mid-afternoon slot trades a small, unproven backtest-fidelity cost for same-day stop handling.

entries.title: Executor: every marketable-limit order carries a price ceiling (no market-order fallback)
entries.description: Two paths that could send an unbounded market order are closed. A leg whose quote cannot price a limit inside regular hours is now skipped (SKIPPED-UNPRICEABLE, alerted) instead of falling back to MARKET. A limit unfilled after the fill wait is re-sent once as a wider limit — 1.5 % through the then-current touch, re-quoted, and only if that quote passes the halt / crossed / spread gate — and a remainder that fails that too is cancelled and alerted, never sent as MARKET. An explicit order_type "market" is unchanged.
entries.impact: Worst-case fill under the default order type is now bounded at every step (first attempt 0.5 % through the touch, second 1.5 %, nothing beyond), at the cost of an occasional unfilled remainder on a fast or thin name that the next run re-plans. Previously a dead quote or a 60-second unfilled limit could print at whatever the book offered.

entries.title: Strategy P&L (C2 as-published): SATA marked at its real price
entries.description: The Collective2 executed-fills replay held SATA flat at its fill price because the close table has no SATA column. It now marks SATA at the price the executed IBKR reports carry (latest mark on/before each bar), falling back to the fill price only when no report has one.
entries.impact: Oct 12-16, 2026: the C2 view read +0.5% (+$512 on $100k) against about -0.2% from C2's own fills and -0.27% in C2's reported account value; SATA fell $99.39 to $97.04 on 302 shares, about -$640 the replay ignored.

entries.title: Strategy P&L badges: down arrow on losses, return to two significant digits
entries.description: Metric badges on the Strategy P&L page put the sign first ("-$88 on ...", "-15.7% CAGR") so Streamlit draws the down arrow and red on a loss instead of an up arrow. The headline Strategy P&L return now shows up to two significant digits (-0.19%, +0.51%, +12%) instead of one decimal.
entries.impact: Oct 12-16, 2026: IBKR #…6572 read "-0.2%" with a red up arrow on -$88 and a green up arrow on CAGR -15.7%; both now point down, and the return reads -0.19%.

entries.title: Walk-forward replay: fund each bar from the position held going into it
entries.description: replay_gated_allocation funded day t from the engines' position AFTER day t's close, so a sleeve exited on the bar whose close produced the signal was dropped before earning that bar: every exit day's return was skipped (look-ahead no account can trade). It now funds day t from the state after bar t-1 (pos_series lagged one bar), the decide-at-close-t-1 / fill-at-close-t convention of the per-sleeve engines and of the live accounts. Entries are unchanged (a sleeve's own stream earns nothing on its fill day).

entries.title: Collective2 orders sent at 2:20 PM CT (was 2:30 PM)
entries.description: The cron-job.org trigger for publish-c2.yml now fires at 2:20 PM America/Chicago, the slot the IBKR executor runs; the workflow's backup-slot guard, the runbooks (COLLECTIVE2.md, COLLECTIVE2_SETUP.md, EXTERNAL_SCHEDULER.md, LIVE_MULTI_ACCOUNT_MOC.md) and the C2 timing notes in the code follow. The IBKR executor is unchanged: it submits MOC orders at 2:20 PM CT that fill in the 4:00 PM ET auction.
entries.impact: C2's market orders now fill about 3:20 PM ET instead of 3:30 PM ET, 40 minutes before the close; nothing else about the book or the fills changes. Dispatches through 2026-10-16 still landed at 2:30 PM CT, so the first 2:20 PM run is the next trading day.

entries.title: SATA leg earns SATA's real total return instead of a flat coupon
entries.description: Every P&L path (walk-forward replay, as-published book replays, attribution and daily P&L, the frictions simulation, the health monitor's realised-book leg, the SATA benchmark line) now prices the SATA leg on SATA's realised daily total return (close + dividend, data/sata/sata_daily.csv, refreshed by the publish workflow) from its 2025-11-06 listing; the 13%/250 coupon stays in force before that. The weight optimiser keeps the coupon as its idle-leg expectation. sata_daily is duck-typed: a float is the coupon, a Series the real record (overall_core.sata_leg).
entries.impact: Since listing SATA returned +24.3% (price $88 -> $96.89 plus dividends) against the coupon's +13.1%, with 25% annualised volatility and a -16% week in June 2026. V2 Balanced, coupon -> real: full CAGR +53.7% -> +54.8%, Sharpe 1.88 -> 1.90, since-listing MDD -9.7% -> -12.0%; Combined Balanced full CAGR +56.8% -> +56.6% (2% mean SATA weight under V1 logic). Oct 6-16, 2026: Combined replay -0.74% -> -1.34%; Oct 13-16: -0.30% -> -0.88% against C2's -0.95%, closing the gap that was entirely SATA's -2.2% slide.

entries.title: As-published records and the replay priced on one table: SATA at its close, retired sleeves priced
entries.description: The C2 and IBKR fills replays marked a held SATA position off the executor's ~3:15 PM ET reads; the price table now carries SATA's official close (data/sata), the same source the walk-forward replay's SATA returns come from. The price-returns matrix behind the as-published book replays and the fills replays' weight columns is built on the COMBINED universe, so a retired sleeve a book or an account still held (OIH under V2) earns its own return instead of reading as cash. The replay view also says when the window starts before the C2 record's first fill (it opened in cash) and gives both figures from that close.
entries.impact: Oct 7-16, 2026: C2 record +1.03% (SATA at close; +1.08% on the 3:15 PM reads) against the published books' +1.06%; the Combined replay reads +0.40% over the same window, 0.55 pt of the gap being the Oct 9 V1->V2 cutover (the replay switches on the signal date, the live book two sessions later) and the rest the walk-forward anchors' sizing versus the live optimiser's.

entries.title: Combined view switches to V2 when the first published V2 book filled
entries.description: The Combined replay (and the combined per-sleeve streams behind it) switched from V1 to V2 logic on the first V2 signal day (STRATEGY_VERSION_START, 2026-10-09). The live accounts can only trade a published book, and the first V2 book (as_of 2026-10-11) filled at the 2026-10-12 close, so the live book ran V1 for two more sessions. A new STRATEGY_VERSION_LIVE_START (2026-10-13, the first bar earned under a published V2 book) now drives the engine splice, the replay splice and the start of the V2 rules in the Combined view; STRATEGY_VERSION_START still labels books and admits them to the as-published record.
entries.impact: Oct 7-16, 2026: the Combined replay read +0.40% against the C2 as-published record's +1.03% with 0.65 pt of the gap on Oct 9-12, when the replay was V2-sized (sold GLDM/UGL/OIH, bought XOP and SATA) while the live book still held the last V1 book through gold's and energy's Oct 9 rally. After: Combined Balanced +1.13% over Oct 7-16 (Growth +2.14%), day by day within a few bp of the C2 record except the sizing residual; full-history Combined figures unchanged (Balanced CAGR +56.8%, Sharpe 1.52).

entries.title: Realized P&L by asset also shows bought-and-held sleeves
entries.description: The Realized P&L by asset chart used to drop every sleeve that never listed a sale ticket, so held positions (e.g. XLE, ERX, XOP from September) vanished. They now appear as a 'no sales yet' row with their open P&L as the lighter unrealized extension.
entries.impact: Realized + unrealized on every row still equals that sleeve's P&L-by-asset bar; the 'locked in' title total is unchanged.

entries.title: Collective2 model account P&L defaults to Oct 7, 2026
entries.description: The As-published record measured on the Collective2 model account now opens its Strategy P&L on October 7, 2026 (the as-published start) instead of the executed curve's first bar; earlier dates remain selectable.

entries.title: SATA buy/sell P&L and dividends in every P&L view
entries.description: The executed-fills replays (Collective2 and IBKR) now add the dividends a held SATA collects on top of its price move, so portfolio value and every metric carry SATA's full total return. The Realized P&L by asset bars gain a SATA line: the gain on each slice SATA hands to a new entry (price vs dividends split on hover) plus its unrealized part, reconciling to the SATA bar of the P&L attribution.
entries.impact: Before, the executed views marked SATA at its close only (dividends missing) and the realized bars omitted SATA entirely.

entries.title: SOXX live panel shows the 25-day MA
entries.description: The SOXX top panel on the Live tab now shows the 25-day MA (title and value) instead of the 20-day MA, matching the 25/100 dual-MA signal.

entries.title: Reconcile Strategy P&L with the C2 account value
entries.description: A new expander under the Strategy P&L metrics bridges Portfolio value now to the Collective2 account's Total portfolio value in labelled steps that add up exactly (taxes toggle, P&L before the start date, bars after the end date, live vs official-close marks, C2's reported value vs its fills), plus an execution-shortfall line comparing the compounded target books with C2's executed fills.
entries.impact: The two headline numbers differ by design; the bridge shows which step explains each dollar and isolates execution cost from everything else.

entries.title: Recurring monthly deposits for IBKR U22546572 ($200) and U22636213 ($500)
entries.description: Strategy P&L now credits $200 / $500 on the 22nd of each month (next trading day on a weekend or holiday) from October 2026 onward, via a new 'from' month in account_deposits.json. Deposits are excluded from P&L and counted in money put in, portfolio value and the money-weighted return.
entries.impact: Dollar P&L, portfolio value and money-weighted return no longer treat deposited cash as profit.

entries.title: Today's plan Chg % stays fixed after hours
entries.description: Once an equity/ETF session has closed, Chg % shows today's close vs the previous trading day's close instead of collapsing to 0.00%. Bitcoin and other crypto keep tracking the live price.
entries.impact: After-hours rows no longer read 0.00% once the sleeve ingests today's bar.

entries.title: Daily include/exclude for the published target books
entries.description: New data/overall/book_exclusions.json (per paper/live book, written only by the Target Book page's 'Publish with these exclusions' button, which commits it and dispatches the publish) is applied by the publisher and the intraday stop check: listed positions are left out of the signed book and their weight goes to SATA/cash. Each list is stamped with its CT date and applies to that day only; the next day's book is the strategy's, unamended, so exclusions must be repeated daily. The Target Book viewer pre-unticks them. Nothing is excluded by default.
entries.impact: Unticks in the UI were session-only, so the viewer re-included SOXX/SOXL on reload and the executor still traded them; the published books now omit them.

entries.title: 'Publish with these exclusions' button moved next to 'Publish new target book'
entries.description: The exclusions publish button now sits at the top of the Target Book page beside the plain publish button; it acts on the Paper/Live view currently selected and the names unticked in its table.

entries.title: Paper Target Book treats SATA as the idle bucket, like Live
entries.description: The Paper view listed SATA as an ordinary, untickable position in the Target allocation table and counted it in Positions; it now handles SATA as the idle bucket exactly as the Live view does. Legacy cash-only paper books render as before.

entries.title: Excluded positions stay listed (unticked) so they can be put back
entries.description: Positions dropped by an exclusion vanished from the Target allocation table, so they could not be re-ticked. They now show as unticked rows (weight and price are stamped into the book as excluded_detail); ticking one and pressing 'Publish with these exclusions' restores it.

entries.title: Stop sending the book to Collective2 via API — IBKR fills feed C2 through Broker Transmit
entries.description: The IBKR account is now linked to the C2 strategy through C2 Broker Transmit, which publishes the account's fills as the strategy's trades. publish-c2.yml no longer runs publish_c2.py --execute (SetDesiredPositions); the read-only C2 positions snapshot and the after-close snapshot continue. The as-published C2 P&L and Executed Book already follow the snapshots' fills, so they keep updating; the c2_book_archive of target books stops growing. The snapshot's book_as_of now follows the current target book instead of the (no longer advancing) sent-book marker.

entries.title: C2 Executed Book drift sized against the IBKR account
entries.description: With C2 mirroring an IBKR account through Broker Transmit, the C2 view's allocation-drift panel divided holdings by C2's $100k model-account value, so an IBKR account of a different size read as a uniform underweight. The panel now offers each live IBKR account's net liquidation (the run standing on the snapshot's day) as the denominator, defaulting to the second IBKR account (the only one when there is a single account), with the C2 model account still selectable.

entries.title: C2 Executed Book: weights, cash and pie sized against the IBKR account; fix duplicate-widget crash
entries.description: The C2 positions table's Weight %, the cash figure and the donut still used the C2 model-account value, so the pie showed ~54% cash against a 40% target even after the drift table was re-based. The sizing selector now sits above the holdings and drives all of them. Also fixes a StreamlitDuplicateElementId crash on the C2 page (the selector's key had been commented out) and a dollar-sign rendering glitch in its caption.

entries.title: Live book: MACD sleeves (GRID) now exit/enter on the live price
entries.description: live_exit_keys / live_entry_keys skipped MACD-mode sleeves, so when GRID's live MACD 10/20/9 histogram turned negative the Recommended Live Possible Targetbook still held it. They now re-evaluate the MACD histogram with the live price as the provisional close, like the MA / dual-MA sleeves.
entries.impact: The live recommendation now matches what the MACD filter will do at the close; the published Current Targetbook is unchanged (it still commits only at the close).

entries.title: Targetbook page: Live account default, timestamps in US Central
entries.description: The Targetbook page now opens on the Live account (when a live book is published) instead of Paper, and the 'generated' badge shows US Central time instead of UTC.
